arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-main-preflight.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/project"
cd "$tmp/project"
echo "REAL_MAIN_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 -m codex.runtime_sync
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
echo "REA_MAIN_SOURCE_PREFLIGHT=PASS"
